cells.gaps: Measured results are reported for the courts' AI speech-to-text only (EGY-023); none for the customs, health, social protection, tax or agriculture systems.
cells.note: Justice (EGY-001, EGY-011, EGY-022), customs (EGY-006), health (EGY-007), social protection (EGY-009), agriculture (EGY-016) and tax (EGY-021) each have AI in service, read across sources (ruling 170). The ICT minister reported in August 2025 that the courts' AI speech-to-text in service at East Alexandria Court exceeds 96% accuracy (EGY-023), a measured result, so stage 5.
